focus_candidates.label: Single point of gravity
focus_candidates.guard: A concentrated reading may not be used to justify concentrating spend on a single surface without a separate reach case.
focus_candidates.limitations: Concentration is a structural observation; it does not by itself rank which surface should receive the concentration.

focus_candidates.label: Restraint as the operating mode
focus_candidates.guard: If the deliverable requires a large-volume launch, this claim is the first to be re-tested against the reach claim C003.
focus_candidates.limitations: The contrary palace 8 display cluster (E085, E086, E095) is left visible and carries the reach function; the two readings coexist by palace, not by contradiction.

focus_candidates.label: Display is the reach engine
focus_candidates.guard: Reach built here is display-reach; it must not be reported as trust or conversion.
focus_candidates.limitations: The marker 丙加乙 names cooperation; it does not name a platform or a format.

focus_candidates.label: Value accrues through quiet channels
focus_candidates.guard: Private-channel value is slow; it may not be used to promise a fast conversion ramp.
focus_candidates.limitations: The same palace's stems sit at the cut-off and death stages (E077, E078): the channel is favourable in kind but currently depleted in force.

focus_candidates.label: Announcement through the alliance channel fails
focus_candidates.guard: Do not use this claim to argue against partnership itself; it constrains the message, not the alliance.
focus_candidates.limitations: The marker is polarity-tagged inauspicious in the register; the alliance deity in the same palace is tagged favourable. Both stay visible.

focus_candidates.label: Three friction registers
focus_candidates.guard: Friction markers forbid forcing, not acting; nothing in this claim forbids trying a method once and measuring it.
focus_candidates.limitations: The counter-evidence is explicit: the same palaces carry sprouting and maturing stages (E038, E041), so the registers are impeded rather than dead.

focus_candidates.label: The centre is held under contest
focus_candidates.guard: The centre's own marker is favourable to the guest and unfavourable to the host; do not read this as a licence for aggressive comparative positioning.
focus_candidates.limitations: The centre has no gate and no deity in this chart, so the disposition cannot be stated through a gate office.

focus_candidates.label: One closed circulation
focus_candidates.guard: A connected structure argues for one system, not for one channel; the claim says nothing about which route is fastest.
focus_candidates.limitations: The ring is a relation over stem values only; it is not a claim about timing or about the strength of each edge.

focus_candidates.label: Two axes are already bridged
focus_candidates.guard: A bridged axis is a channel, not a recommendation; it says the two ends can speak, not that they agree.
focus_candidates.limitations: Only two of the six Luoshu axis relations exist in this chart's opposition rule; the other pairings are not oppositions at all.

focus_candidates.label: Temporal weight sits twice on palace 7
focus_candidates.guard: Branch-to-palace binding is derived from the chart's own stage annotations; it may not be extended into weekdays, hours or campaign dates.
focus_candidates.limitations: The chart supplies no civil date or clock time, so the temporal reading is structural only.

focus_candidates.label: The opening is real but pressed
focus_candidates.guard: Do not read maximum stage as permission to launch without preparation; the house in this palace presses its gate.
focus_candidates.limitations: The gradual-reveal marker is a general reading; the chart does not state a schedule.

focus_candidates.label: Subject stem and subject seat diverge
focus_candidates.guard: Divergence is a recorded state, not an invitation to pick the flattering half; both halves must appear in any recommendation that cites this claim.
focus_candidates.limitations: The stem-and-branch reading follows the standard subject binding declared in the dependency assumptions; that binding is assumption-indexed.

focus_candidates.label: Auspicious combination on a depleted substrate
focus_candidates.guard: A depleted substrate argues for sequenced effort, not for delaying the start indefinitely.
focus_candidates.limitations: The doubled marker (E016, E018) restates the combination on the hidden plate; it is corroboration of the same reading, not a second finding.
